head: 5cae24fbdf456dcf06932d9ed83a4c600d538136
verdict: Do not directly transplant existing path-filter batch helper into every full-staging window; first resolve repeated unindexed literal selection and adversarial ownership semantics.

current_path.fact: Original file iteration, snapshot helper per file.
Snapshot entry uses defer_files_literal_fts=false, snapshot_leaf_batches=true; public deferred-FTS entry instead disables leaf batching.
Two INSERT SELECT mirrors per <=200 paths, selected by base file_path.
Main units complete before route, hierarchy, config units, metadata and graph-signature baseline.

sql_reduction.normal_per_row: F files plus L surviving literal rows cause F+L explicit mirror execute calls.
sql_reduction.window_bound: Existing helper IN_BATCH_SIZE=200. A 256-file window needs four mirror statements, not two; a <=200 window needs two.
sql_reduction.retained_cost: Both FTS indexes still receive every surviving row and tokenize all the same content. INSERT SELECT reduces API/bind/step crossings, not total logical rows or tokenization.
sql_reduction.no_leaf_regression: Calling existing insert_file_data_deferred_fts directly would turn snapshot_leaf_batches off; a new internal both-flags-true seam would be required.

blocking_performance_risk.source: index_db_rebuild.rs 261-267 drops all explicit indexes before write_fn; direct_writer.rs 157-174 emits DROP for every schema CREATE [UNIQUE] INDEX; schema index_v1.sql 324 idx_literal_file is among them.
blocking_performance_risk.consequence: literal_index retains literal_id PRIMARY KEY and rowid indexes but no file_path lookup index during full staging. Repeated WHERE file_path IN windows can scan the ever-growing literal table: O(total_literals * number_of_windows), approximately quadratic when densities stay fixed.
blocking_performance_risk.certainty: Source fact proves the intended file_path index is removed; an actual EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN was NOT executed. The unindexed-scan complexity is a source-based risk/inference, not a measured query plan or timing.
blocking_performance_risk.files_mirror: files.file_path is a PRIMARY KEY and its SQLite autoindex is not a schema CREATE INDEX statement; the analogous files SELECT is not affected by the explicit-index removal.

semantic_review.normal_valid_data: Within the same transaction, source rows and assigned rowids survive unchanged; SELECT inherits literal OR IGNORE winners. Final flush before route/config/metadata keeps original publication/epoch boundary.
semantic_review.file_duplicates: files INSERT has a PRIMARY KEY conflict; batching must not deduplicate/skipsucceed duplicate files. Original insertion order must remain; a duplicate still errors.
semantic_review.ownership_precondition: Old literal per-row mirror uses the actually inserted literal.file_path, while batch helper only selects unit.rel_path. Literal file_path FK can reference an already-existing earlier file; there is no equality CHECK tying it to the current FileWriteUnit. A late literal attributed to a prior flushed path would be omitted by a current-window path filter. Existing normal parser convention does not prove equality for all accepted seam inputs; require adversarial case or a semantics-preserving rowid-based mirror.
semantic_review.cross_window_literal_id: OR IGNORE cross-window duplicate ids must not remirror previously mirrored winners; selecting by fresh paths usually protects this but ownership mismatch makes that assumption insufficient.
semantic_review.errors: Delaying FTS statement errors changes first-error order relative to later leaf/file constraints, triggers, allocation, I/O and SQLITE_FULL. Transaction rollback/publication remains fail-closed, but exact historical first-error string/order cannot be claimed for the naive scheme.
semantic_review.config_units: Leave write_config_units unchanged and flush main units before it; parsed scanner paths are refs-only while unseen config paths get whole-row insertion.
semantic_review.budgets: Borrow <=256 existing path string references only, no cross-file leaf payload accumulation; no registration/workload/deadline change.

existing_measurement.head: 0272a1fb152fd76a7cfb22386a580629d4038a64
existing_measurement.interpretation: This stage includes schema/open/drop-index/write/recreate/restore as well as payload preparation; no FTS substage was emitted. It neither demonstrates FTS dominance nor measures/refutes this proposed full-staging change.
existing_measurement.existing_microbenchmark: incremental_write_bench.rs 310-328 probes deferred FTS on the incremental path. Such a fully indexed incremental measurement cannot establish full-staging speed with idx_literal_file dropped. No archived matching measured result was found in the inspected tracked artifacts text.

next_low_cost_falsifiers_only_not_execut: Use original full-staging schema/pragmas/drop-index setup for a small EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN of both SELECTs; inspect whether literal selection scans.

Compare original writer and an explicit candidate on identical tiny fixtures spanning window boundaries (0/1/199/200/201/255/256/257), varied literals, within/cross-window literal-id duplicates, literal paths referring to an already-created prior file, and repeated file conflicts.

Require complete canonical tables plus files/literal/chunks/file_paths FTS rowids+contents/MATCH results and precommit error/rollback/publication checks; canonical 15 tables alone may omit FTS mirrors.
Only after semantic parity, compare bounded small alternating AB/BA runs under the actual drop-index staging adapter with actual per-stage observation, before considering a new formal P/R/G.
alternative_design_options_not_approved: Defer only files_fts while retaining per-literal original mirror calls: avoids the unindexed literal selector and cross-window ownership issue, but still changes files-FTS error scheduling and needs explicit controls.

A snapshot-only fresh-rowid-range mirror could avoid path scans and ownership mismatch, but requires an explicit proof of fresh-empty table, monotonic auto-rowids/no deletes or explicit rowids, OR IGNORE survivors and overflow/bound assumptions. It is a new design, not an automatic reuse of existing helper.
Retaining idx_literal_file during staging changes index-maintenance workload and expands scope; do not silently add an index and assume a win.
